title: BlobUploadResponse.sha256 doc does not say format or when present
description: blob.rs BlobUploadResponse.sha256 (lines 22-23): field doc is 'SHA-256 hex digest of the blob, if provided by the server'. Does not say: (1) what format the string is (64-char lowercase hex), (2) under which spec capability the server will include it (JMAP-CID), or (3) that the client verifies this value and returns BlobIntegrityMismatch on mismatch. A user calling upload_blob and receiving an error needs this context. Suggested fix: expand the doc comment with format spec and reference to the JMAP-CID capability.
